title: Legal Metrology Rule Specification — v1.1
description: Machine-readable rule definitions for the SIH screening prototype. Based on the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (GSR 202(E)), including amendments through G.S.R. 629(E) 2017 and G.S.R. 128(E) 2026.
source_authority: Central Government, Department of Consumer Affairs, DPIIT
amendment_note: v1.1 adds Rule 6(1)(b) common name, Rule 6(1)(aa) country of origin, Rule 6(1)(da) best before date, and Rule 6(2) consumer care email (informational). Rules based on original 2011 text + 2017 amendment (G.S.R. 629(E)) for country of origin and best before. 2026 amendments (G.S.R. 128(E), G.S.R. 312(E), G.S.R. 418(E)) are noted but do not add new image-screening rules.

version_history.description: Initial MVP: manufacturer name, net quantity, MRP, date of manufacture, consumer care phone, manufacturer address
Added: common/generic name, country of origin (conditional), best before/use by (conditional), consumer care email (informational)

rules.title: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Name Present
rules.detection_summary: Pattern match for qualifier phrases ('Manufactured by', 'Packed by', etc.) with adjacent entity name

rules.title: Net Quantity Declared with SI Unit
rules.detection_summary: Regex match for numeric values with SI unit symbols (g, kg, ml, L, cm, etc.)

rules.title: MRP / Retail Sale Price Present with Value
rules.detection_summary: Keyword match for 'MRP'/'Max. Retail Price' near numeric value with currency symbol

rules.title: Month and Year of Manufacture/Packing Present
rules.detection_summary: Date pattern recognition for month+year combinations, optionally near date-related keywords

rules.title: Consumer Care Telephone Number Present
rules.detection_summary: Phone number regex with false-positive filtering (PIN codes, batch numbers)

rules.title: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Address Present
rules.detection_summary: Address pattern matching (PIN codes, city/state names, street indicators) near manufacturer name

rules.title: Common/Generic Name of Commodity Declared
rules.detection_summary: Keyword and context match for common product descriptors (biscuits, tea, water, soap, etc.)

rules.title: Country of Origin Declared (for Imported Products)
rules.detection_summary: Applicability-aware: detects import keywords, then searches for country-of-origin declarations

rules.title: Best Before / Use By Date Declared (where applicable)
rules.detection_summary: Applicability-aware: detects perishable/food keywords, then searches for best-before/use-by dates

rules.title: Consumer Care Email Address (optional)
rules.detection_summary: Email regex with consumer-care keyword context. Informational only — does not affect score.

status_values.DETECTED: The required field was found in the OCR text
status_values.NOT_DETECTED: The field was searched for but not found
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: Rule does not apply (requires manual product classification, or conditional rule where applicability not established)

evaluation_notes.scope: These rules describe what the software can OBSERVE from a package image. Detection is observation, not compliance.
evaluation_notes.no_legal_conclusion: The system does NOT declare products as 'LEGALLY COMPLIANT'. Detection of a field does not mean the field satisfies the legal requirement.
evaluation_notes.product_category: Product-category exemptions (food, cosmetics, drugs, alcohol, bidis, LPG) are NOT automatically applied. The system checks all products equally. Manual classification is required before production use.
evaluation_notes.conditional_rules: Rules MVP-A8 (country of origin) and MVP-A9 (best before) are conditional: they only apply when import status or perishable status is established from OCR evidence. When applicability cannot be established, these rules return NOT_APPLICABLE and do not affect the score.
evaluation_notes.informational_rules: Rule MVP-A10 (consumer care email) is informational only. Its status does not affect the screening score.
evaluation_notes.amendment_limitation: Rules are based on the original 2011 text + 2017 amendment. The current consolidated law may differ due to additional amendments.
